front.title: Government-Oriented Verification Promotion Boundaries for Agentic Assurance Profiles

abstract.t: Government and critical-infrastructure relying parties require explicit boundaries between successive assurance claims. This document defines Verification Promotion Boundaries (VPB) as a protocol-neutral profile that prevents verification evidence obtained at one stage from being silently promoted to a stronger claim. The stages are REGISTERED, SPEC_VALIDATED, LOCAL_CONFORMANT, INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED, SECURITY_TESTED, and RELEASE_ELIGIBLE. A local PASS does not imply independent reproduction; an independent reproduction does not imply security testing; and no stage implies endorsement by any standards body or government agency. The profile further distinguishes subject evidence (negative findings against the tested artifact) from verifier evidence (positive findings that the verification system correctly detected defects). Arithmetic and protocol preconditions, including on-curve validation before metamorphic fixtures, are mandatory before any promotion. This document is intended for high-assurance government deployments and is not a U.S. Government standard.
